The Ministry of Defence today signed contracts worth over 53 thousand eight hundred crore rupees with Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited and Goa Shipyard Limited for the acquisition of eight next-generation corvettes for the Indian Navy.The contracts were inked in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh in New Delhi.Under the contracts, Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers Limited will construct five corvettes, while Goa Shipyard Limited will construct the remaining three.The Ministry said that the project marks a significant milestone as it is the first project in which the ships will be indigenously designed by the Indian Navy and constructed by Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) selected through a competitive process.These next-generation corvettes will be equipped with state-of-the-art capabilities, including advanced missiles, weapons and sensor suites, enabling them to undertake missions across the air, surface and subsurface domains.The Ministry said that the induction of these ships will significantly enhance the Indian Navy’s operational capabilities in safeguarding maritime trade routes, conducting anti-surface and anti-submarine warfare operations, strengthening coastal defence, undertaking littoral combat operations, and carrying out maritime presence and surveillance missions.It said that the project will provide a significant impetus to India’s indigenous shipbuilding ecosystem by strengthening collaboration among DPSUs, private shipyards and Indian industrial partners, including MSMEs.The construction of these ships is expected to generate approximately 72 lakh person-days of employment in the shipyards and 460 lakh person-days in ancillary industries and MSMEs over the next ten years.

. In a remarkable display of faith, devotion and collective participation, Bhutan today witnessed the simultaneous raising of 108 sacred Buddhist stupas, each standing 15 metres tall, in Gelephu Mindfulness City.The historic undertaking began at 3 AM local time, following traditional Buddhist prayers and religious rituals. The raising of the 108 structures was heralded by the sounding of 58 sets of traditional dungchen, or long Buddhist horns.Envisioned by the King of Bhutan Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck, the initiative brought together around 40,000 volunteers from across the hill nation. People from different walks of life travelled to Gelephu to participate in the historic undertaking, making it an unprecedented exercise in collective religious and community participation. Thousands more gathered to witness the occasion.In an extraordinary display of coordination and voluntary service, volunteers worked simultaneously at 108 designated sites to raise all the structures in a single day. The effort reflects Bhutan’s long-standing tradition of Zhabto, or voluntary service for religious and community initiatives.Each chorten stands 15 metres tall, with 108 metres between consecutive structures. Together, they form an approximately 12-kilometre spiritual corridor along the banks of the Mau Chhu river, making the project remarkable both in its religious significance and physical scale.The main ceremony is being held in the presence of the Bhutanese Royal Family, with the country’s highest spiritual authority, Je Khenpo leading the religious observances. The King also addressed the gathering.The historic occasion coincides with Lhabab Düchen, commemorating Lord Buddha’s descent from the heavenly realm, and the 18th Coronation Anniversary of the King.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi today. He will also address the gathering on the occasion.The four-day Summit will be held till 5th of this month. The theme of the Summit is ‘Invest Innovate Inspire’.Akashvani correspondent reports that the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 will attract participants from over 130 countries, including more than 40 Ministers, along with policymakers, investors, financial institutions and industry leaders.It will serve as a global platform for clean energy investment, industry engagement and technology partnerships. The Summit is witnessing the participation of Australia, Denmark, the European Union, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom as Country Partners.The Summit is being held alongside the 9th Session of the International Solar Alliance Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen.The Summit will also host plenary sessions, ministerial discussions, and government-to-government engagements to promote investment, partnerships and project development.Meanwhile, the Expo will feature over 400 exhibitors showcasing advanced technologies, Indian manufacturing capabilities and clean energy solutions across solar and wind power, green hydrogen, energy storage and other emerging areas.

. In the ongoing 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship in Jalandhar, India maintained its unbeaten run by defeating Malaysia 4-2. Both teams had remained unbeaten in the championship until India overcame Malaysia today. This was India’s fourth consecutive win in the tournament.In the first match of the day, South Korea thrashed Bangladesh 5-0. This was Bangladesh’s fourth consecutive defeat, while South Korea registered its second win in four matches.The second league match between China and Japan ended in a 2-2 draw.Tomorrow, India will take on South Korea, China will play Bangladesh, and Japan will face Malaysia.

. A CBI team has successfully extradited Sourabh Chandrakar, the promoter and mastermind behind the 6,000-crore rupee Mahadev Online Book illegal betting syndicate, from Oman to India. Following an Interpol Red Corner Notice, Chandrakar was located and detained by the Royal Oman Police.A CBI team flew to Muscat, Oman, to escort him back. He will be produced before the special CBI Court in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, today.Chandrakar faces severe criminal charges stemming from separate probes launched at the request of the Chhattisgarh government. He is named as a principal accused across two filed chargesheets detailing criminal conspiracy, cheating, forgery, and public servant bribery under the Prevention of Corruption Act and the Chhattisgarh Gambling (Prohibition) Act.The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has filed a prosecution complaint regarding massive money laundering. Illicit gains were allegedly distributed through broad networks of mule accounts, layered through multi-tier transactions, and syphoned out of India via hawala operations.According to investigators, the Mahadev Online Book operation was one of India’s largest transnationally managed illegal gambling syndicates. It offered users illegal bets on cricket, football, card games, and diverse events via localised franchise “panels” and “branches”.A portion of the proceeds was routinely used to pay off public servants to secure seamless and unhindered operations for the syndicate.

. The government today launched the sixth edition of the National Startup Awards to recognise outstanding startups across the country. The awards recognise not just commercial success but also social impact, sustainability, and scalability. Launching the awards in New Delhi today, DPIIT Secretary Amardeep Singh said that startups can apply under 20 sectoral categories. He said that in addition, there are three special categories for women, students, and the North Eastern region. He added that the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade is at the forefront of driving reforms to promote startups. Mr Singh also emphasised the need for more private initiative to bring more startups in the country. He expressed hope that the awards would further boost the startup ecosystem in the country. The Secretary highlighted that the award covers a wide range of domains including agriculture, fintech, aerospace, health, education, and accessibility, among others. The applications for the award will remain open until 20 November this year.In line with the Government’s vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat and the goal of a five-trillion-dollar economy, Startup India supports startups through initiatives such as startup recognition, tax exemptions, regulatory ease, funding access, and capacity building. Launched in 2016, Startup India has transformed India’s entrepreneurial landscape, fostering innovation and empowering youth, women, students, and first-time founders, particularly from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. Over two lakh 25 thousand startups have been recognised by DPIIT so far.

. The country’s gross Goods and Services Tax (GST) collections grew nearly 23 per cent year-on-year to over Rs 2,31,000 crore in October this year, driven by robust domestic economic activity and a sharp rise in tax revenue from imports. According to the provisional government data released today, gross GST revenue from domestic sales climbed 15.8 per cent year-on-year to over 1.59 lakh crore rupees in October, while revenue from imports surged 42.2 per cent to 72, 246 crore rupees.The gross GST revenue collection includes Central GST mop-up of 42 thousand 935 crore rupees, State GST of 51 thousand 340 crore rupees and Integrated GST of 1 lakh 37 thousand 15 crore rupees.Goods and Services Tax refunds increased 6.5 per cent year-on-year to Rs 27, 934 crore rupees last month. After adjusting for refunds, net GST revenue increased 25.6 per cent to 2.03 lakh crore rupees in October, compared with over Rs 1.61 lakh crore in the corresponding period last year.

. The government has constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to review the country’s banking sector and recommend reforms in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047.The Finance Ministry said that the Committee will recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make the Indian banking sector globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient. The Committee will be chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel.Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Indian Bank Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan will be its members. The Joint Secretary (Banking) in the Department of Financial Services will serve as the Member Secretary. The Committee will have a tenure of six months. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman had announced the setting up of the Committee in her Budget speech this year.The Committee will assess existing banking practices and prudential norms, identify global best practices and examine their suitability for adoption in the Indian banking system. It will also review the existing regulatory and legal frameworks governing banks, including Regional Rural Banks and Cooperative Banks, and suggest reforms to improve efficiency and ease of banking.In addition, the Committee will prepare a roadmap for the adoption of artificial intelligence and digital innovations in banking institutions, while recommending safeguards against cyber risks.

. Indian Railways has announced 1,265 vacancies for Station Master posts across various Railway Recruitment Boards and zones, opening up new employment opportunities for graduate candidates. The Railways Ministry said that in an important recruitment-related decision, the Railway Board has prescribed that Station Master recruitment will be notified separately from 2026 onwards. The dedicated recruitment process provides candidates with a specific notification covering eligibility requirements, examination procedures and vacancy distribution for the post. The online application window will remain open till 25th of next month. Candidates are advised to review the detailed eligibility conditions, vacancy distribution and application instructions before submitting their forms. The recruitment reflects Indian Railways’ continued efforts to provide career opportunities to eligible candidates while strengthening its operational workforce.

. The United States has warned Iran against using disruptions to maritime traffic through the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz as leverage over the regional and global economy, amid rising tensions between Washington and Tehran.The warning comes after remarks by Iranian Defence Minister Mehrdad Akhlaghi, cautioning that any attack on Tehran would be met with a proportionate, decisive and impactful response.Washington has reiterated its willingness to pursue diplomatic engagement while warning that it is prepared to consider alternative measures if normal shipping operations through the strait are not restored.Speaking at the Manama Dialogue security forum in Bahrain, US Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs Donald Blome said diplomatic channels remained open but cautioned that American patience had its limits.Meanwhile, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran was engaged in discussions with Qatari mediators over a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within 48 hours, provided Washington accepted Iran’s conditions. Tehran has also demanded formal recognition of a new maritime shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz, reportedly developed in coordination with Oman, along with the closure of alternative routes.Separately, Iran’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that it had designated the United Kingdom’s Royal Navy and Royal Air Force as terrorist organisations.The Iranian Foreign Ministry accused the British government of pursuing policies and actions that it said violated the principles of the United Nations Charter and international law.No response has yet been issued by the United Kingdom regarding Iran’s announcement.

. The depression, a remnant of Cyclone Arnab, over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining south Odisha has moved northwards.It is now centred over central Chhattisgarh and adjoining Odisha. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said it is likely to move further north and weaken into a well-marked low-pressure area over north Chhattisgarh tonight.Meanwhile, IMD has issued a red alert for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall in Bihar tomorrow.An orange alert has been issued for very heavy rainfall in East Uttar Pradesh, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow. Heavy rainfall is also expected in Jharkhand and Uttarakhand.Thunderstorms accompanied by hail are likely over East Rajasthan, Haryana, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh.Thunderstorms and gusty winds are also forecast in several other states, including Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Assam and Meghalaya.Meanwhile Delhi witnessed light to moderate rainfall this evening. The IMD has forecast very light rain accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning tomorrow morning.The maximum temperature is expected to remain between 26 and 28 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature is likely to range from 16 to 18 degrees Celsius.

. Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri has emphasised prioritising diplomacy over conflict, cooperation over confrontation, protection of seafarers and shipping and preservation of international law, especially UNCLOS. He shared India’s perspective at the 5th Plenary Session “Maritime Security at an Inflection Point” of the 22nd IISS Manama Dialogue Regional Security Summit in Bahrain today. Ministers and senior dignitaries from across the globe participated in the three day Dialogue.

. The seven OPEC-plus countries have decided to maintain their September 2026 production quotas unchanged for December. The decision was taken during a virtual meeting held today to review global market conditions and outlook. The seven OPEC-plus countries are Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi today said that India’s clean energy transition is gathering pace, with solar power playing a growing role in meeting the country’s energy needs.Mr Modi said this while sharing an article written by Union Minister of New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi and founder of Bloomberg L.P, Michael R Bloomberg.The Prime Minister noted that the article stresses the growth of renewable energy, the expansion of rooftop solar and investments in storage and transmission. It also highlighted how this shift is helping reduce electricity bills, create jobs and strengthen energy security.Sharing another article written by Mr Joshi, the Prime Minister said that India’s solar energy journey is opening up new opportunities. Mr Modi said that the Union Minister has highlighted the growth of solar power in India, driven by initiatives such as PM Surya Ghar and PM-KUSUM.Mr Joshi, in his article, also stressed what lies ahead for India, from solar-powered agriculture and energy storage to manufacturing and green jobs, as the country works towards its 500 Gigawatt renewable energy target.

. Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz has declared a national emergency to address the effects of El Nino. Paz said it will facilitate the mobilisation of financial and human resources, improve coordination among government agencies and strengthen efforts to secure international assistance.According to the President, 63 communities across Bolivia have already been affected by drought, while the livestock sector is facing significant shortages of animal feed.Meanwhile, Myanmar’s Yangon region has established more than 600 heat relief shelters, with a combined capacity of over 150,000 people, to protect residents from extreme temperatures amid forecasts of a strong El Nino event.El Nino is a climate phenomenon marked by unusually warm sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean.

. In Archery, India has registered an impressive medal haul at the ongoing Swiss Open IWS Archery Championship, with Sachin Chechi, Tania Rani and Priya Gurjar winning silver medals and Aditya Wadhwa securing bronze.Sachin claimed medal in the Compound Under-21 Men’s category, in a closely contested final against Germany’s Simon Moritz. Chechi went down narrowly by 145-147 against the Under-21 World Record Holder and U-18 World Champion.In the Compound Under-21 Women’s category, Tania Rani also finished with a silver medal. She faced Youth World Championship medallist Fenna Stallen in the final, bringing India its second medal at the championship.In the compound Women’s category, Priya Gurjar defeated Mexican Andrea Maya Becerra Arizaga to clinch the white medalAditya Wadhwa secured bronze in the Recurve Under-21 Men’s category. He defeated Slovenia’s Gal Frank by 6-2 in the bronze medal match to seal his place on the podium.

. Akashvani will broadcast the recording of the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, delivered by Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, tonight at 9:30 PM. The recording will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani network on the occasion of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s birth anniversary.Delivering the 67th Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, Mr Chouhan said that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s vision, determination and leadership laid the foundation for India’s national unity and territorial integrity. He said that Sardar Patel’s efforts to integrate 565 princely states remain a defining chapter in the country’s history. The Minister emphasised that Patel’s vision of a united India continues to inspire the nation through the spirit of ‘Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat’.Mr Chouhan also said that, inspired by Sardar Patel’s firm approach towards national security and his policy of zero tolerance towards terrorism, India has responded decisively to threats from across its borders, including through measures such as surgical strikes.As a tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who served as independent India’s first Deputy Prime Minister and Information and Broadcasting Minister, Akashvani has been organising the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture since 1955. Over the years, the annual event has served as a rich repository of thoughts, ideas and perspectives on a wide range of subjects. It has also provided an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of India’s diverse cultural heritage and the various dimensions of its developmental challenges.

. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold shed over one and a half per cent to 1,40,054 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, silver plunged 4.8 per cent to 1,81,344 rupees per kilogram, according to the closing rates from the India Bullion and Jewellers Association.

. India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal during the next three days. According to IMD, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Coastal Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Mahe are expected to experience heavy rainfall today.MetDepartment has also predicted thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds over East Rajasthan, Konkan, Goa, Lakshadweep, Madhya Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh today. Similar weather conditions are likely to prevail over Odisha, Rayalaseema, Telangana, Coastal Karnataka and South Interior Karnataka for the day.For Delhi, the Weather Agency has forecast a clear sky today.

. The country’s foreign exchange reserves declined over 1.2 billion US dollars to 719.7 billion US dollars during the week ended on 23rd of this month. According to the Reserve Bank of India’s data, Gold reserves dropped by 2.6 billion US dollars to 103 billion US dollars. Country’s reserve position with the International Monetary Fund fell four million to 4.78 billion US dollars.In contrast, Foreign currency assets, the largest component of the reserves, rose 1.3 billion US dollars to 593.2 billion US dollars during the week. Special Drawing Rights grew by 27 million US dollars to 18.6 billion US dollars.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has completed 25 years in public service, a journey defined by the mantra of Jan Seva Se Desh Seva, and a relentless commitment that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasan, the Government has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. Through inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today, in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated into action through initiatives like Jan Bhagidari.Jan Bhagidari, which means public participation, is a core governance model under Narendra Modi government. Schemes that utilize the Jan Bhagidari model include Swachh Bharat  Mission, Catch the Rain, Vocal for Local, and Pradhan Mantri TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan. Citizens in India had traditionally been treated as passive beneficiaries of government schemes. Jan Bhagidari has brought a change to this and fostered local ownership and behavioural change in people. Prime Minister Narendra Modi regularly highlights Jan Bhagidari as a core pillar of nation-building through his monthly radio program, Mann Ki Baat. In Mann Ki Baat  last month, Prime Minister Modi again highlighted Jan Bhagidari as a driving force for social change, urging citizens to join collective movements like the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.Talking to Akashvani News, Shivendra Singh, a resident of Prayagraj, spoke about how he and his family and friends believe in Jan Bhagidari and go Vocal For Local during festive seasons.Participation has now become ownership of transformation happening around the country, with the people becoming stakeholders in national development.

In Nepal, all six Indian tourists stranded in the Upper Dolpa region due to heavy snowfall have been safely rescued and brought to Dunai.The District Administration Office has confirmed that all six are in normal condition.The tourists were airlifted by helicopter after heavy snowfall blocked trekking routes in the Danigad area. The rescue operation was jointly coordinated by the district administration and security agencies.

. The seven OPEC-plus countries have decided to maintain their September 2026 production quotas unchanged for December. The decision was taken during a virtual meeting held yesterday to review global market conditions and outlook. The seven OPEC-plus countries are Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman.

. Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju represented India at the consecration ceremony of 108 Stupas in Bhutan’s Gelephu Mindfulness City, led by the King of Bhutan, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuk today. The Ministry of Minority Affairs said Mr Rijiju’s participation reflected the shared spiritual and cultural heritage and longstanding friendship between India and Bhutan.The 108 Stupas project was conceived by the Bhutan King who also steered its implementation. In a single day, thousands of volunteers erected 108 Stupas, each 15 metres tall and separated by 108 metres on an 11.7 kilometre stretch along the Aie River within Gelephu Mindfulness City near the border with Assam. During the ceremony, Bhutan’s King, Prime Minister and Minister Rijiju offered prayers at Stupa No. 76, dedicated by the King to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in recognition of his commitment and steadfast support for Gelephu Mindfulness City. Mr Rijiju conveyed the Prime Minister’s gratitude for the special gesture.Both sides appreciated the close bilateral ties and progress in cooperation across development partnership, trade, energy, investment, connectivity and cultural exchanges. Mr Rijiju reaffirmed India’s support for Gelephu Mindfulness City and its potential to promote development in neighbouring regions of India alongside Bhutan.

. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has announced a significant relaxation in the Know Your Customer (KYC) review rules for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) to boost the ease of doing business. Under the new guidelines issued today, the market regulator has increased the periodicity of KYC reviews for various categories of FPIs.As per the new guidelines, for Category-One FPIs from non-high-risk jurisdictions and certain high-risk entities registered under specific regulations, the KYC review will now be required only once every eight years instead of the earlier shorter timeline. For other FPI categories, including regulated entities and non-high-risk Category-Two investors, the review period has also been rationalised to every eight years, while remaining at every two years for certain remaining entities.In another major relief aimed at reducing the compliance burden, SEBI has completely dispensed with the requirement for FPIs to intimate changes in information or submit a no-change declaration at the time of continuing their registration. FPIs wishing to continue their registration for a subsequent block of three years will now only need to pay the required fees to their Designated Depository Participants (DDP) at least 15 days prior to the expiry of their validity. The regulator said that the KYC review timelines for FPIs investing exclusively in Government Securities and SWAGAT-FI FPIs will remain unchanged. These new provisions are set to come into force with effect from 1st December of this year.

. A Learjet 60 business aircraft carrying nine people crashed in a residential area of Palm Beach County in Florida yesterday. It had departed from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport in Texas and was heading to North Eleuthera Airport in the Bahamas.The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said both it and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) would investigate the incident, with the NTSB leading the probe.The safety board has dispatched an investigation team to the crash site. Authorities have not yet confirmed the condition of the nine people on board, possible casualties, injuries on the ground or the extent of damage to nearby homes. The cause of the crash is also not known.Palm Beach County Fire Rescue said it was responding to an aircraft incident and announced the closure of Military Trail between Cresthaven and 10th Avenue North, urging residents to avoid the area.

Ukraine’s public air raid alert app was hacked, briefly issuing false warnings of nuclear and chemical threats, street fighting and the deployment of a Russian hypersonic missile.Ukraine’s Air Force said that yesterday the compromised application sent alarming notifications to users in Kyiv and other parts of the country.One false alert also claimed that Russia had deployed its Oreshnik hypersonic missile. The Air Force confirmed the incident in a statement on Telegram, warning that the application had apparently come under enemy influence. The alerts later disappeared from the application.Ukraine’s Ministry of Digital Transformation said the application had been temporarily taken out of operation. However, other public warning systems remained functional, including air raid sirens, ensuring that residents could continue receiving alerts about potential Russian attacks.The incident came amid growing concerns over cyberattacks targeting public infrastructure and information systems during Russia’s war against Ukraine.According to the state news agency TASS, Russia’s mobile application for the Emergencies Ministry was also hit by a major cyberattack, resulting in the circulation of false information among users.It is not immediately clear whether the cyberattacks targeting the Ukrainian and Russian applications were connected or part of a coordinated operation.

. India once again remained unbeaten, frustrating Malaysia by 4-2 in the 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship in Jalandhar, Punjab, yesterday.Capt Harmanpreet Singh played a pivotal role in the win. India continues to lead the table at the top spot.Both teams were undefeated in the championship till India surpassed the opponent last evening. This is India’s fourth consecutive win in the championship.In the first match of the day, Korea thrashed Bangladesh by 5-nil. This was Bangladesh’s fourth consecutive defeat. The second league match between China and Japan ended in a draw as both teams hit 2 goals each.Akashvani correspondent reports that it was again Sarpanch Sahib – Capt Harmanpreet Singh – who demonstrated his class with a hat-trick by converting two penalty corners and one penalty stroke into goals.Although Malaysia played an offensive hockey but could not surpassed the defending champion India’s technique and presence of mind on the ground.With today’s results, all four teams qualifying for the semi-finals have been decided.While India and Malaysia had already reached the semi-finals, Japan and South Korea secured their place in the last four. China and Bangladesh, being out of the semi-final race, will play for the 5th position.Today, India will take on South Korea, China will play with Bangladesh and Japan will face Malaysia. Rajesh Bali, Akashvani News, Jalandhar.

. Secretary West in the Ministry of External Affairs, Sibi George, participated in the Commonwealth Ministerial Meeting on Small States at the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2026 in St John’s, Antigua and Barbuda.Spokesperson in the External Affairs Ministry Randhir Jaiswal said that the theme of the meeting was ‘Scaling up Partnerships and Investment for Resilient Small States’.During the meeting Mr George highlighted the multiple intersecting crises faced by Small States. He also emphasised India’s commitment to support Small States and Small Island Developing States in addressing these challenges through partnerships rooted in mutual respect, national priorities, common aspirations and shared capabilities.

. The deep depression over Bay of Bengal has intensified into cyclonic storm Murasu. India Meteorological Department (IMD) said Murasu is likely to make landfall along the Andhra Pradesh coast between Nellore and Narsapur, close to Ongole, in the early hours tomorrow as a severe cyclonic storm.IMD Director General Mrutyunjay Mohapatra said the wind speed of the cyclonic storm is likely to be between 80 and 90 km per hour, with occasional gusts up to 100 km per hour.The Met Department has advised fishermen not to venture into the Southeast Bay of Bengal till today and into the Southwest Bay of Bengal till Wednesday morning.IMD has issued a red colour warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall over Coastal Andhra Pradesh today.IMD has issued an orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Rayalaseema, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal and Telangana today.Heavy rainfall is also expected over Chhattisgarh, Kerala, Mahe, Odisha and South Interior Karnataka during the next two days.Weather Agency has predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Konkan, Goa, Madhya Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh during the next two days.

. The Government has notified the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB-G RAM G – Grievance Redressal Rules, 2026, establishing a structured, multi-tier and time-bound mechanism for addressing grievances relating to the implementation of the Scheme.The Ministry of Rural Development said that the rules aim to make grievance redressal more accessible, transparent and accountable, while ensuring that citizens’ concerns receive timely attention and appropriate action.The Ministry said that the Rules provide for the establishment of a time-bound, multi-tier grievance redressal mechanism by State Governments at the Gram Panchayat, Block and District levels. It said that designated Grievance Redressal Officers at the appropriate levels will be responsible for receiving, registering, enquiring into and disposing of grievances.To facilitate easy access, any person may submit a grievance relating to any matter arising out of or connected with the implementation of the Scheme.The Rules provide for submission of grievances in person before the designated Grievance Redressal Officer, through speed post, with proof of delivery, through the Digital Public Infrastructure for Redressal of Grievances designated by the Central Government and through telephone.The Rules also prescribe clear timelines to ensure prompt examination and resolution of grievances. The enquiry into a grievance is required to be completed within seven working days and resolved within 15 days from the date of its receipt.The Ministry of Rural Development said that the multi-tier institutional mechanism, multiple channels for grievance submission, mandatory registration, defined timelines, digital tracking and escalation of unresolved grievances are expected to strengthen administrative accountability and improve the responsiveness of the Scheme’s implementation.

. In Men’s Cricket, hosts New Zealand defeated India by 7 wickets in the final T20 International of the five match series in Hamilton. Chasing the target of 192 runs, New Zealand scored 195 for 3. Earlier, put into bat first, India posted 191 runs for the loss of 8 wickets in their allotted 20 overs.Despite the defeat, India clinched the series 3-2. The Men in Blue won the first three matches, while New Zealand staged a comeback by securing victories in the final two games, including the fourth match in Auckland on Friday.

. Indian Army personnel Biten Singh has won an international endurance sports competition, the Ironman 70.3 Goa, India 2026 international triathlon, in the men’s category.He also set a new course record by completing the event in four hours, 24 minutes and 29 seconds. Earlier record was made by Uzbekistan’s Konstantin Belousov in 2025 in four hours, 25 minutes and 47 seconds.Ironman 70.3 is an internationally recognised triathlon event comprising three stages: 2 kilometres of swimming, 90 kilometres of cycling and 21 kilometres of running. The event was held today along the Miramar beach in Goa.More than 2,000 athletes from over 30 countries participated in the sixth edition of the event.In the women’s category, Marina Shliakhtina clinched the title, completing the event in five hours, 30 minutes and 29 seconds. Sabina Iskakova finished second, while Mellanie Vendt  secured third place.

. In Badminton, Double Olympic Medallist PV Sindhu clinched her second title of the season with a commanding straight-games victory over Denmark’s Line Hojmark Kjærsfeldt in the final of the Hylo Open Super 500 tournament. The former world champion showcased exceptional control and precision in her stroke-play, defeating the world No. 25 and eighth seed 21-12, 21-14 in just 39 minutes.The triumph earned the world No. 8 Indian 9,200 ranking points, strengthening her bid to qualify for the season-ending BWF World Tour Finals.Earlier, Second seed Sindhu entered the summit clash with a dominant 6-1 head-to-head record against Kjærsfeldt, whose only victory over the Indian came at the 2025 Sudirman Cup Finals. Earlier this year, Sindhu made history by winning the Japan Open.

. The Securities and Exchange Board of India, SEBI, is taking several steps to protect investors from online financial fraud and scams through social media.Speaking to the media in Kolkata, SEBI Chairman Mr. Tuhin Kanta Pandey said, the regulator is working to make investors more aware and ensure safer investments.As part of these efforts, SEBI is working with Google to introduce special verified badges on the Google Play Store so that people can identify genuine SEBI-related apps.SEBI has also started a WhatsApp channel on investor awareness in eleven languages, including Bengali.The SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facility will help investors check and verify accounts before making transactions in the securities market.SEBI has also developed an artificial intelligence-based tool called ‘Sudarshan’. It will help identify violations and suspicious activities across social media platforms through a five-stage checking process.The regulator is also running the ‘Samajh ke Investing Simple’ campaign in different regional languages to help people understand investments better.In addition, the SCORES 2.0 portal has been introduced to help investors register complaints, including complaints related to financial fraud.Speaking about West Bengal’s economic growth, Mr. Pandey said the state’s economy is estimated to have grown by 7.6 per cent in the financial year 2025-26.He also pointed out that the number of investors from West Bengal in the securities market has increased significantly. The number has crossed 90 lakh, compared to around 12 lakh in the financial year 2014-15. Interestingly, around 36 per cent of these investors are below 30 years of age.He further said that more than 40 small and medium-sized businesses from West Bengal have raised over 1,400 crore rupees through SME Initial Public Offerings, or IPOs.These figures show the growing interest of people in the state’s financial and investment markets.Mr. Pandey said, investor awareness and protection remain SEBI’s top priorities. The regulator aims to make the securities market safer and help people make informed investment decisions.However the chairman made it clear that the revival of the century-old Calcutta Stock Exchange will depend on its ability to attract sufficient trading volumes, build a sustainable business model and make substantial investments in technology.

Lakshya Sen and PV Sindhu won their respective men’s and women’s singles titles at the Hylo Open 2026 in Saarbrucken yesterday, bringing home double badminton glory for India.PV Sindhu became the first Indian woman to win the Hylo Open women’s singles crown, beating Denmark’s Line Kjaersfeldt 21-12, 21-14 in the final.Entering her second BWF tournament final in as many weeks, double Olympic medallist Sindhu dominated the game to clinch her first title since the Japan Open in July.On the other hand, Lakshya defeated defending champion Jonatan Christie of Indonesia 21-17, 21-10 to win the Hylo Open men’s singles crown for the second time. It is Lakshya’s first BWF title of the year and makes him the first Indian to win two titles at the Hylo Open.

. Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan today inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium in New Delhi.Addressing the event, the Vice President described the Games as a celebration of courage, determination, compassion and the precious gift of life. Mr. Radhakrishnan also described organ donation as a ‘Mahadaan’, through which hope can endure even in the face of loss. He said that the organ donation movement in India has received significant impetus from the consistent emphasis placed on the subject by Prime Minister Narendra Modi through his ‘Mann Ki Baat’ addresses.The Vice President emphasised that the Games celebrate the resilience of transplant recipients and demonstrate the life-transforming power of modern medicine. He also commended the participants for their courage, discipline and sporting spirit, noting that their achievements inspire hope among those awaiting transplantation.Calling for greater awareness about organ donation, the Vice President stressed the need to dispel myths and misconceptions, encourage informed decisions and motivate people to share their wishes with their families. He further called upon everyone to make organ donation a powerful expression of shared humanity and work towards a society where more patients receive transplants and fewer lives are lost while waiting for organs. He also paid his deepest respects to deceased organ donors and their families, whose selfless decisions give others a second chance at life. Mr. Radhakrishnan appreciated living donors for exemplifying the finest values of love and compassion. He added that one deceased organ donor can save up to eight lives.On the occasion, Mr. Radhakrishnan witnessed an attempt to set a world record, featuring 570 transplant recipients and donors performing Tadasana together. Following the successful attempt, the organisers were presented with a certificate by the World Book of Records, New Delhi, for the ‘Largest Congregation of Transplant Recipients and Donors Performing Tadasana’.During the programme, the Vice President released the ‘Zindagi Dobara’ Calendar and felicitated the medal winners of the World Transplant Games 2025, held in Dresden, Germany. He also joined the gathering in taking the Organ Donation Pledge and witnessed exhibition matches in Kabaddi, Table Tennis and Badminton.Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare Prataprao Jadhav was also present on the occasion.

. Union Minister of New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi has said that more than 21 lakh of the 65 lakh homes with PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar have received a zero electricity bill.In an article for a daily newspaper, Mr Joshi highlighted that solar power that cost around eight rupees a unit in 2014-15 now sells for as low as 2.15 rupees.He emphasised that under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, India has achieved both speed and scale, with installed solar capacity up by around six thousand per cent in the last 12 years.Mr Joshi further said that India stands as the only G20 country to have met its 2030 target of 50 per cent non-fossil capacity five years early.Talking about the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026, he said that for the first time the summit will host the 9th International Solar Alliance Assembly and 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen together.He added that the summit will provide a platform for countries to discuss how reliable power, energy security without imported fuel, and food security through solar irrigation can be achieved, all in the spirit of Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam.The Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 will be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi today.

. US President Donald Trump has defended the US military campaign against Iran and claimed that American intelligence agencies spy on China and Russia more effectively than they spy on the United States. He made the remarks while addressing supporters at campaign rallies in Iowa and Kansas yesterday, ahead of tomorrow’s midterm elections.Speaking at a rally in Dubuque, Iowa, Trump dismissed concerns over Chinese and Russian espionage, saying the United States was also monitoring both countries and was doing so more effectively.Defending the military action against Iran, Trump claimed that the country had lost its radar systems, anti-aircraft capabilities and leadership. He said the United States was finishing what it had not started and added that Washington was looking for someone in Iran to negotiate with.At a following rally in Salina, Kansas, Trump turned his focus to the economy, claiming that inflation had declined to 1.7 per cent over the past three months.He blamed the previous administration for high prices and maintained that oil prices were lower than during the presidencies of Joe Biden and Barack Obama.Trump also said fuel prices would fall sharply once the war with Iran ended. He described the higher fuel costs as a small price to pay for the security of the United States and the world.

. Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the ‘Shatabdi Samaroh 2026’ organised by the Akhil Vishwa Gayatri Pariwar in New Delhi yesterday.The ‘Shatabdi Samaroh 2026’ is being organised to mark the completion of 100 years of the birth of Param Vandaniya Mataji of Akhil Vishwa Gayatri Pariwar and the manifestation of Akhand Jyoti.Addressing the ceremony, Mr Shah said that the 100 years of the manifestation of Akhand Jyoti, the 100 years of the birth of Vandaniya Mataji, and the 100 years of the sadhana of Pujya Gurudev Pandit Shriram Sharma Acharya – the confluence of these three sacred streams is taking place this year.He said that, based on his experience, he believes the Gayatri Mantra is the path to complete transformation. Mr Shah said that the 24 letters of the Gayatri Mantra are directly connected with our 24 auspicious nodes.Taking the 24 letters of the Gayatri Mantra as the foundation and receiving the sanskar (values) of its pure pronunciation from one’s Guru, if we awaken the 24 auspicious powers, the inauspicious powers lying within us are subdued and the auspicious powers emerge.He said that these 24 auspicious powers are linked with 24 kinds of attributes, which include foresight, restraint, austerity, courage, discrimination, intellect, protection, production, service, vitality, love, valour, concentration and others.He said that in a person in whom these 24 auspicious qualities arise, the path to ‘moksha’ (liberation) automatically opens and God leads him in that direction.

. Global crude oil prices rose over two per cent today amid geopolitical concerns. Brent crude was trading 2.7 per cent up at 117 US dollars and 97 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading 2.4 per cent higher at 104 US dollars and 44 cents per barrel, at the time of writing this report.

. The Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare will conduct the month-long fifth nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) campaign across the country from the 1st of next month. Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions Ministry said that this is the biggest-ever DLC Campaign undertaken by the Ministry. Electronics and Information Technology Ministry and UIDAI will provide technical support during this campaign. The Ministry said that the initiative will be adopted with a Whole of Government approach with the objective of reaching pensioners in the remotest corners of the country with focus on Face Authentication Technology. The Ministry said that face Authentication for Digital Life Certificate is a seamless and fast mode for DLC generation which can be used both on Android and Apple devices, making it easy and convenient for elderly Pensioners.The Campaign will be conducted in an Utsav mode by offering a bouquet of services such as Health Check-ups and Aadhaar updation for pensioners. Doorstep services to be provided to pensioners based on their requirement.

. The ongoing 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship at Olympian Surjit Singh Hockey Stadium in Punjab’s Jalandhar has crossed the halfway and is entering the final phase. Each team has already played three league matches. The remaining two will be played today and tomorrow at the Jalandhar stadium, and then the action will move to Mohali for the semi-finals and final.India and Malaysia have already secured their places in the semi-finals after winning their three consecutive matches each. Akashvani’s Jalandhar Correspondent reports that India tops the points tally owing to the highest number of goals scored, which is 22, in comparison with Malaysia, which has scored 14 and is sitting pretty at second place. Japan is at third place with two victories and South Korea has one victory, occupying fourth place. China and Bangladesh are yet to open their accounts.Of the total six participating teams, the first four teams would advance to the semi-finals while the teams finishing fifth and sixth place in the league phase are to play for the fifth-position. All knockout stage matches would be played at the Olympian Balbir Singh Senior Stadium in Mohali on November 4th and 5th.After yesterday’s rest, today India will take on Malaysia, South Korea will play with Bangladesh whereas China will try its luck against Japan.

. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh met newly appointed Chief of Air Staff, Air Chief Marshal Asutosh Dixit. In a social media post, Mr Singh said that Air Chief Marshal Dixit is a distinguished air warrior known for excellent leadership. The Defence Minister also wished him a wonderful tenure ahead.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has said that the deep depression over East central and adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal has moved southeastwards and intensified into a Deep Depression today. IMD added that the deep depression is very likely to move nearly southwestwards, and intensify further into a cyclonic storm over east central adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal by early morning tomorrow. It has advised fishermen not to venture into West Central and adjoining Northwest and Southwest Bay of Bengal during the next two days.The Weather Agency has issued an orange colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal tomorrow. Heavy Rainfall is also expected over Coastal Andhra Pradesh during the next two days.The Met Department has predictedthunderstormsaccompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Gangetic West Bengal, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar Islands during the next two to three days.For Delhi, the IMD has forecast a clear sky tomorrow. The maximum temperature in the National Capital will be around 31 to 33 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature will hover around 15 to 17 degrees Celsius tomorrow.

Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat today highlighted that India’s civilizational consciousness will offer valuable guidance in dealing with present day challenges in the country. The Minister stated this at the book launch of Timeless India: Protection and Revival of Indian Cultural Identity under the leadership of the Prime Minister in New Delhi. Mr Shekhawat said that this book offers a unique perspective on the initiatives undertaken by the government to safeguard and revive India’s rich cultural heritage. He emphasised that preserving and revitalising this legacy is essential not only for safeguarding the country’s historical identity but also for shaping its future.This book is written by Former Rajya Sabha Member Tarun Vijay and  published by Indira Gandhi National Centre of Arts and Surbhi publication.

Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal has emphasised that country’s next phase of economic transformation must be driven by young entrepreneurs who look beyond the domestic market and aspire to build world-class brands. He said this while interacting with students at the Festival of Ideas, held in New Delhi today.Mr Goyal said that with an expanding start-up ecosystem, manufacturing capabilities, various free trade agreements and deeper integration with global value chains, country offers immense opportunities for young Indians to createglobally competitive enterprises and generate employment. The Minister also encouraged the youth to seize emerging opportunities across manufacturing, deep technology and high-value services with a strong export-oriented mindset,globally benchmarked quality, industry-relevant skills and the confidence to take calculated risks.

. India has won 14 medals, including four gold, two silver and eight bronze, at the 46th International Tammer Boxing Tournament held in Tampere, Finland. The Indian contingent finished at the top of the medal tally at the international event, which concluded yesterday.Aarti Dhariyal in the women’s 54-kilogram category, Ankushita Boro in the women’s 65-kilogram category, Arundhati Chaudhary in the women’s 70-kilogram category and Pawan Bartwal in the men’s 55-kilogram category clinched gold medals for the country.Mohammed Hussamuddin in the men’s 60-kilogram category and Jaismine in the women’s 57-kilogram category secured silver medals.The eight bronze medallists for India included Vivek Meena (men’s 65kg), Hitesh (men’s 70kg), Akshay (men’s 80kg), Bobin Chauhan (men’s 90kg), Chetan Choudhary (men’s 90+kg), Tanu (women’s 51kg), Disha Patil (women’s 60kg) and Imroz Khan (women’s 75kg).

The India Meteorological Centre (IMD) has said that a well marked low pressure area over Eastcentral and adjoining Southeast Bay of Bengal persisted over the region today.It is most likely to persist over the region and intensify into a depression today. It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a deep depression tomorrow and into a cyclonic storm over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal by Monday morning.Under the influence of likely formation of cyclonic storm over the Westcentral Bay of Bengal by Monday and its further intensification, isolated extremely heavy rainfall is expected  over Coastal Andhra Pradesh on Tuesday and Wednesday and  further over Odisha and Telangana on Wednesday.IMD has issued red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall over Kerala, Mahe, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal tomorrow.The Met Department has forecast Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep and South Interior Karnataka will experience heavy rainfall tomorrow. The weather agency has said that thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds is likely over East Madhya Pradesh, and Andhra Pradesh tomorrow.

. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has reported a sharp acceleration in bank credit growth, alongside a decline in interest rates on fresh loans and deposits during the month of September this year.According to the RBI’s latest data, non-food bank credit grew 19.1 per cent year-on-year as of 30th September, compared to 11.2 per cent in the corresponding period last year. Credit to the services sector recorded the highest growth of 28.3 per cent, while agriculture and industry registered growth of 19.5 per cent each. Credit to the personal loans segment grew 17.3 per cent, compared to 11.5 per cent a year ago.The RBI data also shows that the weighted average lending rate on fresh rupee loans declined to 8.51 per cent in September from 8.61 per cent in August. The rate on outstanding loans remained unchanged at 8.96 per cent. Interest rates on fresh term deposits also eased to 5.61 per cent from 5.67 per cent.According to provisional data released by the RBI, country’s services exports increased over 39 billion US dollars in September this year, up 7.2 per cent year-on-year. Imports rose 12.6 per cent to over 20 billion US dollars, resulting in a services trade surplus of around 19.2 billion US dollars.
